**Valmont depot handover**

Established: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, 410 daily departures, 1.8% cancellations, 1100 parts line items. Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028. Ops lead: Halvard Onstad. Night supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic.

Decided: fuel cards need second approval above €200; parts above €500 need two quotations; route changes need 7 days' notice; incidents filed within 24 hours; rosters need one named publisher.

Failed: Feb 2025 brake line failure grounded 9 vehicles 4 days; cause unestablished. Sept 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4200.

Planned: second charging bay Q3; electrification study approved, unfunded.

Open: night shift understaffed; old ticketing terminal on 3 routes; winter peak capacity unmodelled; May 2026 double roster left 2 shifts uncovered.

Rules: brake check every 6000 km; driver training 11 days, curriculum revised April 2026. Parts contract renegotiated Nov 2025; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim.
